contract.nativeRows: Original native response values, unmodified. Collection paging verifies total, offset and distinct original IDs. Full history is not an atomic snapshot.
contract.duration: durationInMillis is retained as an audit comparison; elapsed metrics use exact parsed UTC start/end milliseconds.
contract.taskCompletion: Native task endTime with absent/null/completed deleteReason is normal completion; all other nonempty deletion reasons are separate.
contract.source: The original workspace inventory and native page/resource blobs are retained in the complete workspace export.
contract.processCompletion: Native state completed/cancelled controls ended process classification regardless of caller-supplied deletion reason. Missing state has explicit reason-based inference; unknown states remain unknown-ended.
contract.activityCompletion: The native historic activity REST response omits deletion reason/state, although the engine retains a reason. Report ended duration with completion unknown; never infer activity completion/termination from its parent.
